To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. Nox4 expression is upregulated in vascular cells in response to various stimuli and may be involved in the development of hypertension, atherosclerosis and vascular remodelling.
Nox4 and 5 are important in regulating vascular function and that these Noxes have distinct functions in different cell types and in different vascular beds.

Nox4 and/or Nox5 are expressed in the endothelium, VSMCs (vascular smooth muscle cells), and adventitial fibroblasts of the aorta and coronary arteries, that Nox4 is expressed in the renal vasculature and is a major source of H2O2, that the expression and activity of Nox4 is regulated by a variety of stimuli and that Nox4 may be a key player in the pathogenesis of hypertension and renal disease.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of ROS in the regulation of the vasculature and the mechanisms of action of the different Nox isoforms.
identifying the mechanisms of ROS production in the vasculatures and how these ROS contribute to vascular function and pathology.
the role of ROS in the regulation of the vascular tone, vascular remodelling and vascular cell proliferation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Nox4 and/or Nox5 have an important role in vascular biology, but their specific function in the vasculatory system is not fully understood and requires further investigation.
Nox4 and 5 are novel and important sources of ROS, which have the potential to regulate vascular cell functions and may be involved in the pathogenesis of vascular disorders.
Nox4 and/or Nox5 are likely to play a significant role in the regulation of vascular function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Nox4 and 5 are novel sources of ROS in vasculature, which can be activated by distinct stimuli and generate different ROS species.
Nox4 is involved in cell proliferation, cell differentiation, cell senescence, cell survival and vascular remodelling, and Nox5 is involved in cell migration and vascular remodellings.

Nox4 is a constitutive and regulated source of ROS that may play a role in the development of cardiovascular diseases, whereas Nox5 is a Ca2+-regulated oxidase that may play a protective role in the vasculatures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Nox4 and/or Nox5 may play a critical role in regulating vascular function and may provide new insights for the treatment of vascular disease.
the Nox isoforms, especially Nox4 and the newly discovered Nox5, play a key role in the vascular system and may have an important impact on vascular physiology and pathology.
, in addition to Nox1 and Nox2, which have been extensively studied and reviewed, Nox4 is a major isoform in the vasculatory system and Nox5 may have a role in vascular function.
